description: This file defines a utility class 'LibraryLoader' within the 'Utils' namespace, which manages dynamic library loading and object creation via dlopen, dlsym, and dlclose. It includes methods for loading libraries and creating shared objects, and handles errors related to library loading.

classes.name: LibraryLoader
classes.description: A class that encapsulates dynamic library loading, symbol resolution, and object creation using dlopen, dlsym, and dlclose.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a shared library from a specified path and reports errors if loading fails.

methods.name: CreateShared
methods.description: Creates a shared object of type T by invoking a factory function 'Create' from the loaded library, passing constructor arguments.
